description: Catholic University of Leuven: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Données de réplication pour: Lignes directrices en matière de processu; Un ensemble de données de mesures de force d'arbre électrique, thermiq; Jeu de données pour le manuscrit "Salle pour les énergies renouvelable; Données de réplication pour: Dimensionnement optimal du stockage de ch. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
